text.zh-TW: 邀請碼 FRD6D21F79B。取自平台分享文案，未註明使用條件與期限；以官方公告為準。

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製邀請碼 FRD6D21F79B，再開啟 CHARGESPOT 官方下載頁。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies invite code FRD6D21F79B first, then opens the official CHARGESPOT download page.

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 CHARGESPOT App（支援 iOS 與 Android），並完成註冊與登入；登入需要能接收簡訊驗證。
steps.en: Download the CHARGESPOT app (iOS and Android) as the page directs, then register and log in; login uses SMS verification.

steps.zh-TW: 若 App 有輸入邀請碼的畫面，請貼上 FRD6D21F79B（本站已複製）；貼上沒有成功時請手動輸入，並依原樣（含大小寫）。本站未確認該畫面的位置。
steps.en: Paste invite code FRD6D21F79B if the app offers a place for it (location unconfirmed); if pasting fails, type it exactly as shown (case-sensitive).

steps.zh-TW: 確認 App 內出現 NT$19 優惠券；使用條件與期限以 App 顯示及官方公告為準。
steps.en: Check that the NT$19 coupon appears in the app; conditions and deadlines follow the app and the official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 共享行動電源租借服務，下載 App 即可使用。依分享文案，新用戶下載並登入後可得 NT$19 優惠券；邀請碼 FRD6D21F79B。
intro.en: Power-bank rental service, used through the app. Per the share text, new users can get an NT$19 coupon after download and login; code FRD6D21F79B.

description.zh-TW:
CHARGESPOT 是共享行動電源租借服務：在租借站掃描 QR Code，用 App 租用行動電源，再歸還到租借站。本站的連結不含邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製邀請碼 FRD6D21F79B，再開啟 CHARGESPOT 官方的下載頁。

依平台分享文案，新用戶下載並登入後，邀請人與好友都可獲得 NT$19 優惠券；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告及 App 顯示為準。
description.en:
CHARGESPOT is a shared power-bank rental service: in the app you scan the QR code at a rental station, rent a power bank, and return it at a rental station. The link on this page does not carry the invite code: selecting “Sign up” first copies code FRD6D21F79B and then opens CHARGESPOT’s official download page.

According to the platform’s share text, after a new user downloads and logs in, both the inviter and the friend can get an NT$19 coupon. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements and what the app shows.

notes.zh-TW:
此連結是 CHARGESPOT 台灣官網的下載頁（charge-spot.tw/download），不是邀請人的個人連結；維運者 2026-10-24 開啟時，頁面會轉到 INFORICH App 的 App Store 頁面。分享文案沒有附連結，邀請碼 FRD6D21F79B 需在 App 內貼上或手動輸入。

NT$19 優惠只取自平台分享文案，沒有說明條件、期限與次數；本站未註冊測試邀請碼是否被接受，也沒有查到列出這項優惠的現行官方頁面。官方使用者條款載明，優惠券未經公司明確許可不得複製、販售、轉讓或公開提供；本站只公開平台分享功能提供的邀請碼，邀請碼不等同優惠券。

租借需先綁定付款方式；依官方常見問題與使用者條款，部分第三方電子支付會預先授權 NT$800 再退還差額，未歸還超過 7 天，或用戶導致行動電源不見、受損，也可能收取 NT$800，實際費用以 App 與官方條款為準。未成年人須由法定代理人閱讀並同意條款。

網域查證：App Store 頁面的開發者網站 chargespot.jp 列出台灣站 www.charge-spot.tw，官方條款頁載明台灣營運公司為共享數位服務股份有限公司。注意 charge-spot.tw 有連字號；沒有連字號的 chargespot.tw 不在本站採用的網域內，也未確認屬於官方。
notes.en:
This link is the download page on CHARGESPOT’s official Taiwan website (charge-spot.tw/download), not the inviter’s personal link; when the maintainer opened it on 2026-10-24, it redirected to the INFORICH app’s App Store listing. The share text had no link; invite code FRD6D21F79B must be pasted or typed in inside the app.

The NT$19 offer comes only from the platform’s share text, which states no conditions, deadline or usage limit. This site did not register to test whether the code is accepted, and found no current official page that lists the offer. The official terms of use say coupons may not be copied, sold, transferred or offered to the public without the company’s express permission; this site publishes only the invite code from the platform’s own share function, and an invite code is not the coupon itself.

Rentals require a linked payment method; according to the official FAQ and terms of use, some third-party e-payment methods take an NT$800 pre-authorization with the remainder refunded, and a return more than 7 days late, or a power bank that is missing or damaged through the user’s fault, may also be charged NT$800; actual fees follow the app and the official terms. A minor needs a legal guardian to read and agree to the terms.

Domain check: the developer website on the App Store listing is chargespot.jp, which lists the Taiwan site www.charge-spot.tw; the official terms page names 共享數位服務股份有限公司 as the Taiwan operator. Note that charge-spot.tw has a hyphen; chargespot.tw (no hyphen) is not among the domains this site uses and was not confirmed as official.

q.zh-TW: CHARGESPOT 的邀請碼 FRD6D21F79B 要怎麼使用？
q.en: How do I use CHARGESPOT invite code FRD6D21F79B?

a.zh-TW: 本站的連結不含邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」會先複製邀請碼，再開啟 CHARGESPOT 官方下載頁。下載 App 後，請在 App 內有輸入邀請碼的畫面時貼上或手動輸入，並依原樣（含大小寫）；本站未確認該畫面的位置與時機，也未測試邀請碼是否被接受。
a.en: The link on this page does not carry the invite code: selecting “Sign up” first copies the code and then opens the official CHARGESPOT download page. After you download the app, paste the code or type it in where the app offers to enter an invite code, exactly as shown, including capitalization. This site has not confirmed where or when, and has not tested whether the code is accepted.

q.zh-TW: NT$19 優惠券有使用期限或條件嗎？
q.en: Does the NT$19 coupon have a deadline or conditions?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有說明優惠券的使用期限、次數與條件，本站也沒有查到列出這項優惠的現行官方頁面，所以這些內容不列出。實際內容、金額與期限請以 App 顯示及 CHARGESPOT 官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text does not state a deadline, usage limit or conditions for the coupon, and this site found no current official page that lists the offer, so none are listed here. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow the app and CHARGESPOT’s official announcements.
